line: Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 (2026, AMD Ryzen AI)
config_name: ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 — Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450, 64GB LPDDR5X, 1TB SSD, 14" WUXGA IPS 500-nit touch

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450 (8-core/16-thread: 4 Zen 5 + 4 Zen 5c, up to 5.1 GHz, 40W PL2)
specs.display_type: IPS WUXGA anti-glare touch (500-nit, full sRGB)
specs.keyboard_notes: ThinkPad keyboard 1.5mm travel (1.35mm function row), TrackPoint with mechanical buttons, auto backlight
specs.pen_support: touch enabled, finger only (no stylus support per NBC)

battery.notes: 58Wh. NBC measured this exact config: 'Our Wi-Fi test at 150 nits run for almost 17.5 hours and still 11.5 hours at maximum brightness.'

price.notes: NBC (Jul 2026): the 64GB SKU 'cannot be configured yet, but we definitely expect a price well north of $3,000' US. CAD estimate from >US$3,000 at ~1.3x; CA configurability may lag.

reviews.quote: Excellent business laptop with 64 GB RAM - Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 AMD Review of the Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 AMD with Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450, 64 GB RAM and 500-nit IPS touchscreen.
The 58 Wh battery did not change, but the runtimes are a bit better than before. Our Wi-Fi test at 150 nits run for almost 17.5 hours and still 11.5 hours at maximum brightness.

The matte IPS touchscreen with full sRGB color gamut offers decent image quality and can even be used for picture editing after calibration. The frequency is limited to 60 Hz, but it is good for productive tasks.

praises: This is the exact Notebookcheck 90% review unit — 64GB with no compromises on battery
64GB soldered LPDDR5X is the T14s ceiling and enough for local 20-30B LLMs in shared memory
Measured ~17.5h Wi-Fi battery at 150 nits — best runtime in the class per NBC
Fans often fully off in light workloads; NBC called the noise a clear improvement over Gen 6
WWAN-ready with pre-installed antennas — add a 5G module later without opening surgery
complaints: 64GB tier pricing is brutal — NBC expects well north of US$3,000 for this SKU
64GB still soldered: paid like SODIMM, upgraded like a MacBook
Review unit's 60 Hz cap persists even at flagship price
Latency-test issues on the current BIOS limit real-time audio work (NBC)
Wi-Fi 7 radio limited to 160 MHz — ~1.7 Gbps vs ~3.9 Gbps on Intel BE211 machines

design_philosophy: The halo configuration of the T14s line and the one Notebookcheck used to award it 90%: maximum memory for data-heavy and local-AI workloads inside the same repairable, MIL-SPEC, 1.19 kg chassis. It deliberately trades X1 Carbon weight-saving for RAM headroom, repairability, and the best measured battery in the family.
rating_notes: Direct match to the Notebookcheck-reviewed configuration (90%): Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450, 64GB LPDDR5x-8000, 500-nit matte sRGB IPS touch, 58Wh. All ratings anchored to that review's measurements (17.5h Wi-Fi battery, 86.5 dB speakers, quiet fans). 512GB→1TB storage delta vs review unit is immaterial. ai_ml 7.5 reflects 64GB shared memory for local models plus 50 TOPS NPU.
